chosen.content: The collision between Offshore Supply Vessel Jack Edwards and Cargo Vessel Julie C was caused by failures in the steering system and improper adherence to operational procedures. First, conduct regular testing of hydraulic oil quality; Then, replace hydraulic oil when the system is opened; Next, keep tunnel thrusters online during transit; After that, follow manufacturer’s procedures for maintenance. Use Channel Rule 6, Channel Rule 7 and Channel Rule 14. Use the prowords offshore supply vessel, cargo vessel, steering system failure, risk of collision as appropriate. This follows COLREG 1972, NTSB Safety Recommendations. Be careful: failure to report maintenance issues can lead to accidents. Done correctly, improved vessel control and reduced risk of collision.
